text: TBC Bank (JSC TBC Bank) belongs to TBC Bank Group PLC, a United Kingdom-based parent company listed on the London Stock Exchange (TBCG).
short: TBC Bank is owned by London Stock Exchange-listed TBC Bank Group PLC.

source.name: FT Markets: TBC Bank Group PLC (TBCG:LSE) - Summary, About the company
source.quote: TBC Bank Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based parent company of JSC TBC Bank (TBC Bank) and a group of companies that principally operate in Georgia in the financial sector.
source.note: Undated live market-data page; date is the day it was opened. The listing ticker TBCG on the LSE appears on the same page ('TBCG:LSE').
